name: Forbric Runtime (Forge bridge)
description: The Knot-loaded half of Forbric: the reflective Forge-family runtime drivers (traditional MinecraftForge + NeoForge) that seed each FML environment and bring up @Mod classes beside Fabric mods — packaged as a mod so Knot's transforming classloader loads them where the Mojmap game classes and the real Forge-family runtime live. Both drivers are declared; each idles unless its runtime jar is staged (an instance carries exactly one Forge-family game base).
